sql:
WITH actuals AS (
    SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmount) AS ActualSales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
quotas AS (
    SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS QuotaAmount
    FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
perf AS (
    SELECT
        s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
        st.StoreName AS StoreName,
        a.ActualSales AS ActualSales,
        q.QuotaAmount AS QuotaAmount,
        a.ActualSales / nullIf(q.QuotaAmount, 0) AS Attainment
    FROM actuals a
    INNER JOIN quotas q ON a.StoreKey = q.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore st ON st.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1) s2
    WHERE a.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT StoreKey, StoreName, ActualSales, QuotaAmount, Attainment,
           'Top' AS Performance
    FROM perf
    ORDER BY Attainment DESC
    LIMIT 5
    UNION ALL
    SELECT StoreKey, StoreName, ActualSales, QuotaAmount, Attainment,
           'Bottom' AS Performance
    FROM perf
    ORDER BY Attainment ASC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT Performance, StoreKey, StoreName, ActualSales, QuotaAmount, Attainment
FROM ranked
ORDER BY Performance, Attainment DESC;
